Q5269.reason: Title III affidavits must state a finite interception period plus the offense, the communications sought, and persons if known; an indefinite wiretap is not authorized.

Q5271.reason: Anaemia of chronic disease is common in RA, whereas RF is present in most cases, the disease is polyarticular, and Heberden nodes belong to osteoarthritis.

Q5274.reason: Peroxisomal acyl-CoA oxidase uses O2 while breaking fatty acids down toward acetyl-CoA; glycolysis, the TCA cycle, and glycogenolysis do not consume molecular oxygen.
